Early_Morning (optional): Option 2: Warm water with a squeeze of lemon
Meal_1: Option 1: 2 boiled eggs + any 1 fruit (apple, orange, papaya or guava)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (small portion ~100 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + chicken curry (small portion ~100 g) + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-vegetarian meals to 3-4 times per week as per your preference.
Include plenty of vegetables with both lunch and dinner.
When stress cravings hit, drink a glass of water and wait 10 minutes before eating.
Choose homemade spicy foods instead of packaged snacks.
Maintain regular meal timings even on busy workdays.
Practice yoga consistently and stay well hydrated throughout the day.
